subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish `withSessionTranscriptIndexedWriteLock` and its three indexed persistence facts as a permanent Plugin SDK contract for transcript mirrors?
rationale: The functions are additive but public, documented, baseline-counted API that currently encodes the needs of two bundled mirrors; tests cannot decide the intended long-term plugin boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the SDK contract
options.body: Accept the dedicated indexed lock as public API, define its stable semantics, and require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Rework the access through an owner-approved internal or bundled-plugin seam so external plugins do not inherit mirror-specific persistence facts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated indexed lock as public API, define its stable semantics, and require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the merged transcript foundation and this follow-up, so they are the strongest available routing contact for the API-boundary decision.
